retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style layout featuring landscape photography masked within painterly heart shapes, topped with dense, ultra-condensed blue typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition divided into a typographic top third and an illustrative bottom two-thirds. The illustration features two large, hand-painted heart shapes acting as windows into pastoral landscape scenes, rendered with visible brushstrokes and a muted, sun-bleached color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: The heavy blue header anchors the top edge, creating a structural frame.
The two hearts are symmetrical but distinct in their internal landscape content.
Painterly textures in the foreground contrast with the sharp, photographic details inside the heart masks.
Handwritten script at the bottom provides a human, informal counterpoint to the rigid grid above.
coreInvariants: Ultra-condensed sans-serif typeface for the primary title.
Heart-shaped masks with rough, painterly edges.
A horizontal rule separating the title from the secondary text block.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large hearts occupy the central and lower field, scaled to nearly touch the side margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold blue title at the top acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the heavy title, through the secondary text grid, landing on the large heart illustrations.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cream-colored off-white background provides breathing room around the central heart motifs.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Cream background for a vintage paper feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Royal blue for primary typography and horizontal rules.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural greens, sky blues, and earthy browns within the landscape imagery.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue text, while the imagery is desaturated and hazy, mimicking aged print.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure black; use dark charcoal or deep blue for shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme verticality with very narrow widths.
Uniform stroke weight with minimal contrast.
Tight letter spacing (tracking) to create a block-like effect.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has very short curves to maintain the narrow profile.
The 'M' and 'W' are compressed to the same width as 'I' or 'L'.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, smaller condensed sans-serif is used for tracklists, paired with a loose, ink-drawn cursive script at the bottom.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.
Captures the clean, condensed vintage feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with an off-white paper texture. In the bottom two-thirds, place two large heart-shaped windows. Inside the windows, show hazy 1970s-style landscape photos of houses and fields. Surround the hearts with loose, painterly gouache brushstrokes in white and light grey. Leave the top third empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thick blue horizontal line across the top. Above it, typeset the main title in an ultra-condensed royal blue sans-serif. Below the line, add secondary text in a smaller version of the same font, using dots to separate phrases. At the very bottom, add two words in a loose, black ink-drawn script.

verificationChecks: Is the blue title ultra-condensed and all-caps?
Do the heart shapes have a painterly, non-vector edge?
Is there a clear horizontal rule separating the header from the art?
Does the paper texture look aged and off-white?

adjustableVariables: Color of the primary header text
Thickness of the painterly border around the hearts

avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Helvetica

postGenerationChecks: Check for ink-bleed effect on the blue text.
Ensure the hearts are not perfectly symmetrical vector shapes.
Verify the off-white background isn't pure white.
Confirm the script at the bottom looks hand-drawn.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Ultra-Condensed Blue Header] + [Horizontal Rule] + [Dual Heart Landscape Windows] + [Aged Paper Texture].
